Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. I'd like to begin Jordan's coaching-period review. As you all know, Jordan completed a 60-day communication-coaching period following concerns about dismissive behavior in cross-team planning meetings, particularly affecting quieter participants. I have the authority to determine whether the coaching period is complete and to set Jordan's role and follow-up conditions going forward.

Before we get into the discussion, I want to follow our standard review process. I'll be going through a required round-robin checklist, calling on each of you by name for one relevant observation or requirement. I'll record each response using the meeting's formal disclosure step, then read back the proposed coaching status, facilitator assignment, feedback process, follow-up timing, and written-summary status. Only after each person has had the opportunity to correct the read-back will I record the final plan.

We also need to address the fact that Jordan has not facilitated the weekly cross-team planning meeting during the coaching period, and the team needs a clear plan for the next month.

Let's begin the round-robin. I'll start with the peer observer -- could you please share one relevant observation from the coaching period?
